reason: PURE. What I noticed first was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I'm always running between the gym and the kids and I'd actually remember to take it. $29.99 with free shipping is an easy impulse buy after a creator video about sleep and stress, and the QR lab report is a nice extra.
objection: Two capsules a day, and size 00 capsules are big. If I can't swallow them easily I'll just stop after one box.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the creator swallow the capsules on camera, or a note that they're small and easy to swallow.
